about: The reference Find step (ADR-0055, FD-7): what a match is and the order a step walks, over rows written as the texts their cells display. From tests/ExGrid.Tests/GridFindTests.cs.

cases.name: ADR-0055 / FD-7: by rows, across a row in column order, then down, from the cell after the Focus
ADR-0055 / FD-7: with no Focus, the walk starts at the first cell
ADR-0055 / FD-7: past the last cell the walk wraps to the first
ADR-0055 / FD-7: the cell the step starts from is considered last, so a lone match finds itself
ADR-0055 / FD-7: backward walks the other way and wraps too
ADR-0055 / ADR-0023: case is ignored as OrdinalIgnoreCase ignores it, unless Match case
ADR-0055 / FD-7: containment unless Whole cell
ADR-0055: what is matched is the displayed text, never the raw value
ADR-0055 / FD-7: a scope confines the walk, and a cell covered twice counts once
ADR-0055: a column with no text, or one the source does not know, is skipped
ADR-0055: an empty text asks nothing
ADR-0055 / FD-7: a Focus outside the rows or the columns starts the walk at the first cell, or the last backward
